identity.admin_set_unverified.remediation: Grant the audit identity RoleManagement.Read.Directory, Group.Read.All and Directory.Read.All, rerun the identity and identity_governance collectors, and raise the per-endpoint limit if a list was truncated. The finding's evidence lists each source and why it is incomplete.
references: Microsoft Graph unifiedRoleAssignment, unifiedRoleEligibilitySchedule and group members
identity.admin_set_unverified.expected_value: Role definitions, role assignments, PIM schedules and role-assignable group memberships are collected completely.

identity.admin_holds_productivity_licenc.description: A user who holds an administrator directory role (direct, PIM-eligible or inherited through a group) also holds an Exchange Online mailbox licence or a productivity licence (Microsoft 365 Apps, SharePoint, Teams), taken from the licensing collector. This is partial evidence that the account is used for daily work as well as administration.
identity.admin_holds_productivity_licenc.impact: An administrator account that reads mail and opens documents is the account a phishing message or a stolen browser session reaches, and it carries administrative rights. Cyber Essentials expects separate accounts for administrative activities only.
identity.admin_holds_productivity_licenc.remediation: Give administrators a separate cloud-only account for administration with no mailbox or productivity licence, and keep the daily-use account unprivileged. Use PIM for the roles an individual only needs occasionally.
references: Microsoft Entra privileged access best practices
NCSC Cyber Essentials Requirements for IT Infrastructure v3.3, user access control
identity.admin_holds_productivity_licenc.expected_value: Administrator accounts hold no mailbox or productivity licence.

identity.stale_guest.description: An enabled guest account has no successful sign-in within the staleness threshold (90 days by default, set with AUDITEX_STALE_GUEST_DAYS), with signInActivity observed. A guest that is also an administrator is reported by identity.privileged_stale_account instead.
identity.stale_guest.impact: A guest that is no longer used keeps its access to shared teams, sites and apps, and nobody notices if the external identity is compromised or the partner relationship has ended.
identity.stale_guest.remediation: Remove the guest, or review its access with an access review. Use an access package or access review with automatic expiry for guests that are meant to stay.
references: Microsoft Entra manage inactive user accounts
Microsoft Entra access reviews for guests
identity.stale_guest.expected_value: Guest accounts have signed in within the threshold or are removed.

identity.guest_with_privileged_role.description: A guest account holds an administrator directory role, directly, as a PIM-eligible assignment or through a role-assignable group. Whether the guest's own tenant enforces MFA is not visible from here.
identity.guest_with_privileged_role.impact: Administrative rights held by an identity that another organisation controls depend on that organisation's account security and joiner-mover-leaver process, and sit outside this tenant's lifecycle controls.
identity.guest_with_privileged_role.remediation: Remove the role from the guest, or replace it with a member account in this tenant. If the assignment is a deliberate partner arrangement, document it, keep it PIM-eligible and require phishing-resistant MFA through cross-tenant trust or Conditional Access.
references: Microsoft Entra privileged access best practices
Microsoft Entra B2B collaboration guest access
identity.guest_with_privileged_role.expected_value: Administrator roles are held by member accounts of this tenant.

identity.service_principal_privileged_ro.description: A service principal (an app registration's identity or a managed identity) holds the Global Administrator or Privileged Role Administrator directory role, directly, as a PIM-eligible assignment or through a role-assignable group. The effective administrator set lists it but does not count it as a person, so no administrator count includes it. Whoever controls the application (its owners, anyone who can add a secret or certificate) controls the tenant.
identity.service_principal_privileged_ro.impact: A workload identity authenticates with a secret or certificate that is not protected by MFA or Conditional Access for users, and is often stored in code, pipelines or key vaults. If it is stolen or its owner is compromised, the attacker holds tenant-wide administrator rights, or can grant themselves any role.
identity.service_principal_privileged_ro.remediation: Remove the role. Give the application only the Microsoft Graph application permissions or the narrower directory role it needs, review who owns it and which credentials it holds, and use a managed identity where possible. If the assignment is unavoidable, make it PIM-eligible, scope it, and monitor the identity's sign-ins and credential changes.
references: Microsoft Entra privileged access best practices
identity.service_principal_privileged_ro.expected_value: No service principal holds Global Administrator or Privileged Role Administrator.
